subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters, K, L, M, N, O and P are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown here. Find the letter on the face opposite K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a2bcd8497c585adf7e15a0eb648c253411d1e5da035aae520a5b8d27aebfe37.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'K', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 2 and Dice 3,

When we move in clockwise direction starting from K we get;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3b625dc46ccfeed1c91bd6a32f54cb05e296c923b5a841cad3731ff7fc23a20.png] 

In dice 2, K is adjacent to N and M.

In dice 3, K is adjacent to L and P.

→ K ⇔ K; M ⇔ L; N ⇔ P

So, the remaining 'O' will be the opposite face of 'K'.

Hence, the correct answer is "O".
